name: Lords of Waterdeep
edition: Base game, 2012 Wizards of the Coast rulebook

key_numbers.label: Starting Gold
key_numbers.value: 4 for the first player, then 1 more per seat

setup.text: Unfold the board. Place 3 VP tokens on each space of the rounds track.
Put the Adventurer cubes and Gold tokens in a supply by the board.
Shuffle the Quest cards. Put 1 face up on each of the 4 Cliffwatch Inn spaces and keep the rest as a face-down deck there.
Shuffle the Building tiles. Turn 3 face up in Builder's Hall and keep the rest as a face-down stack.
Shuffle the Intrigue deck and place it face down by Waterdeep Harbor.
Choose a colour. Take that colour's Agents, player mat, score marker and control markers. Put the score marker on 0.
Put your starting Agents in your pool, and 1 more Agent of your colour on the round 5 space of the rounds track.
Deal each player 2 face-up Quests, 2 face-down Intrigue cards and 1 face-down Lord card. Keep Lords secret and box the unused ones.
Give the First Player marker to whoever visited another city most recently.
Hand out starting Gold: 4 to the first player, 5 to the next on their left, and so on, each seat getting 1 more than the one before.

turn.summary: Players take turns assigning one Agent each, in order from the First Player, until everyone's pool is empty. After assigning you may complete one Quest.
steps: Start of round: move that round's 3 VP tokens onto the face-up Buildings in Builder's Hall, one per tile, and carry out any start-of-round effects of Buildings in play. In round 5 each player adds their extra Agent.
Assign an Agent to any empty action space on a Building in play, then take that action once. You may not pass while you have Agents, unless no action is possible.
Builder's Hall: pay a face-up Building's Gold cost, score its VP, place it with your control marker, then refill the space. Its owner gains a benefit whenever another player uses it.
Cliffwatch Inn: take a face-up Quest (with 2 Gold, an Intrigue card, or after replacing all four), then refill the Quest row.
Waterdeep Harbor: play one Intrigue card. After all Agents are assigned, each Agent there is reassigned to another space, starting from space 1.
After assigning, you may complete one Quest: pay its Adventurers and Gold from your Tavern, take the reward, and turn the card face down. Only one Quest per turn, however many Agents you place.
A player with no Agents left is skipped until the round ends.

round_end: After all Agents are placed and reassigned, everyone returns their Agents to their pool.
The player holding the First Player marker starts the next round.
end: The game ends after the 8th round, then final scoring.

scoring.text: Quest rewards, Building VP and VP from effects are added to your track as they happen.
Final scoring: 1 VP for each Adventurer in your Tavern.
Final scoring: 1 VP for every 2 Gold in your Tavern, rounded down.
Reveal your Lord card and score its bonus VP. Plot Quest names are a different colour and keep an ongoing effect once complete.

tiebreak: The player with the most Gold wins.

missed.text: You may complete at most one Quest per turn, even if you assign or reassign several Agents.
Cliffwatch Inn and Waterdeep Harbor have three action spaces, but you still place only one Agent per turn.
You cannot pass your turn when you have an Agent and a legal action.
A Mandatory Quest played on you blocks all other Quests until you complete it.
You cannot reassign an Agent back to Waterdeep Harbor. The Ambassador, if placed at Waterdeep Harbor, cannot be reassigned at round end.
If the supply lacks enough Adventurers to hire, you take only what is available.
The Lord cards stay hidden until final scoring.
